$comment: memory_dir/state_dir default to $AXMEM_HOME/memory and /state — set them ONLY to relocate storage. A '~' prefix expands to $HOME (not AXMEM_HOME).

hermes.$comment: memory_md is RETIRED (P1 D1, 2026-09-16) — AxMem never reads/writes Hermes MEMORY.md/USER.md/SOUL.md (single-writer rule). config_yaml is Hermes's own cli-config.yaml. Leave EMPTY (not '~/.hermes/config.yaml') — unlike codex/claude-code, Hermes's real home is platform- AND env-var-dependent (HERMES_HOME, else %LOCALAPPDATA%\hermes on native Windows, else ~/.hermes — see adapters/hermes/wire.cjs's defaultHermesHome()); a hardcoded '~/...' example value here would silently override that logic and target the wrong file the moment `axmem init` copies this file verbatim into a real config.json. Set this explicitly only if your Hermes install's config.yaml is somewhere non-standard.

generic.$comment: path to the target agent's own instruction file — wire.sh appends a marker-fenced section there. Empty = none configured; enforcement=convention always (D4).

semantic.$comment: optional locator backend; the text channel is always authoritative
